# ADR-061 — Phase 8 is CLOSED (2026-09-12); the four 8.6 owner decisions recorded as Locked

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

**Phase 8 is CLOSED (2026-09-12), and the four 8.6 owner decisions are recorded as Locked.** Closure criteria, all verified first-hand at the closeout (`docs/PHASE-8-CLOSEOUT.md`): every approved checkpoint is implemented or was intentionally terminated by the owner (8.5, after 9.1 h of a 21-day minimum — **no adoption conclusion may be drawn from it**); 8.6A/B/C/D are accepted live; production is healthy at migration **17**; the repository is clean and reproducible (HEAD `81662ff` ≡ `origin`, 3,668 tests / 12 packages reproduced exactly, all gates clean); no known blocker violates a Phase 8 guarantee; and every remaining item is classified and non-blocking. **1. The 8.6 decisions, previously recorded only in `docs/STATUS.md`, are now Locked here.** **D1 — Cloud Ask** (8.6B) is the explicit later decision ADR-056 said widening egress requires: note and task **bodies** may leave the machine, but only when the owner has created the `ask` task route (a one-time disclosed consent in Settings; the row's presence IS the switch, create-or-delete only, `409 ask_route_immutable` on re-point) and only per explicit question, lexically preselected, redacted, hard-budgeted, `maxRetries: 0`, primary model only, no tools, nothing persisted, counts-only logging. It ships OFF. It does **not** make bodies "local by default" — the capture parser has always sent every capture's full `raw_text`, and 8.6B corrected that false premise rather than restating it. **D1f** — all five AI SDK call sites carry `maxRetries: 0` and `experimental_telemetry: { isEnabled: false }`, and the closed set of five is pinned by `apps/api/src/ask/ai-egress-guard.test.ts`; a sixth call site is a test failure. **D1e** (device-token auth on `/ai/*` writes) is **deferred, not decided** — ADR-029 is unamended. **D3–D6 — retention** (8.6C): `monitor_checks` 30 d on `checked_at`, `mail_messages` 45 d on `internal_date`, `mail_digests` 45 d on `digest_date` in the digest's own timezone, `mail_sync_runs`/`health_sync_runs` 30 d on `finished_at IS NOT NULL`; daily `0 4 * * *` UTC; five independent autocommitted DELETEs, `retryLimit: 0`, 1 h expiry. **Irreversible under ADR-024**, which is reaffirmed. This discharges ADR-054's "permitted and required" mail prune in substance; its "configurable" clause is **unmet and recorded** — the windows are constants, chosen by the owner, with no env key. **D7 — monitor target CRUD** (8.6D) reverses the decision gate's "deferred beyond 8.6": CRUD is exposed over the Tailscale perimeter with a narrow `169.254.0.0/16` literal block (private IPs, localhost and Docker hosts deliberately allowed — production's own targets are those shapes), `enabled`/archiving only through dedicated action routes (ADR-039's rule), **archive never hard-deletes** (`deleteMonitorTarget` exists unwired to any route), and an open incident is never auto-resolved. Migration `0016` (`archived_at`) took the level to **17**. **2. Present-state corrections, in the ADR-057 convention** — each affected row now carries a pointer here; no Locked text was edited. **ADR-057 #1**: the `health_sync_runs` half is now swept (8.6C); the OAuth-state half remains open (both sweep functions still unwired). **ADR-057 #2**: the mail prune now exists (8.6C); the window is recorded above and in `docs/STATUS.md`. **ADR-059 and ADR-060** each state "level stays 16"; true when written, the level is now 17. **ADR-060** states `capture.parse` "still has no dead-letter queue"; 8.6A added `capture.parse.dead` with a durable `status: "failed"` record. **ADR-058's** keys were proven live for the first time at the closeout — `health-sync-alert:…:breaker:daily-heart-rate-variability:2026-09-12:…` accepted 2026-09-12T03:00:14Z. **3. Carried into Phase 9 as classified, non-blocking debt** (full table in the closeout record): `occurrences.generate-lazy` and `occurrences.expand-window` retry with no DLQ and no durable failure state — the last known gap in the failure-visibility contract and the recommended first Phase 9 item; the `basic404` raw-URL log path; D1e; the two unwired OAuth-state sweeps; the breaker-disabled HRV stream (an unverified value spec meeting first real data, per ADR-047 design); event text unbounded at write; the literal-regex monitor URL guard; the shared `reminders` channel. **4. Unchanged and reaffirmed:** ADR-018, ADR-024, ADR-046, ADR-056's read-only-before-write-capable rule and pgvector exclusion, and the frozen deployment order. **Phase 9 is not approved by this ADR**; its first gate is an owner decision (Phase 8 closeout, 2026-09-12) **[Present state corrected by ADR-062; D1's scope widened by ADR-066.]**
